hypothesis: A preregistered Phase-5 G0b pricing milestone can separate deliberate-slide generation from obstacle clearance, prove same-plant deep-slide expressibility from a straight pre-slip state, measure earliest four-frame slide onset relative to frozen emergency distances, and persist axle-specific Chrono tire truth before any final reachable-set, paper, promotion, or self-ID claim.

parent_objective: resolve whether M3265 failed because deep slide is too slow for the emergency windows or because its mode search was not expressive
price the slide-entry side of the final dual-proof protocol independently of collision clearance
derived_from: M3265 recovered the known 0.20/0.26 rad/s positive control but failed deliberate-slide mode validity 0/3
M3265 maximum four-frame dwell was 0/1/2 and collision terminated trajectories before the mode gate could complete
M3265 Chrono aggregate tire telemetry was finite but did not identify front versus rear slip
blocked_by: the final matched reachable-set adjudication remains blocked until M3266 proves detailed-plant mode expressibility and valid onset measurement
supersedes: reusing emergency collision cells as the only deep-slide generator test
using all-wheel maximum tire slip for a rear-slide claim
invalidates: lowering the frozen 0.20 rad or four-frame slide definition
claiming an empty slide-only set when same-plant slide entry is not demonstrated
registering final adjudication after a failed detailed-plant positive control

public_gates: write preregistration before quick and full execution
retain the passed M3265 literature positive control
detect a beta=0.24 same-plant Chrono classifier positive control with axle-specific tire telemetry
generate a four-frame beta>=0.20 deliberate slide from beta=0 in every full planar mode cell
persist earliest slide dwell time and distance plus pre-obstacle dwell for every planar cell
generate a four-frame beta>=0.20 deliberate slide from beta=0 in the obstacle-disabled canonical Chrono cell
require rear-axle tire slip >=0.15 rad for the Chrono entry gate
replay the best Chrono entry action sequence within absolute tolerance 1e-9
keep final reachable-set dominance false regardless of the M3266 decision
forbidden_shortcuts: do not lower mode thresholds or dwell after reading quick or full results
do not add slide-only actuator or yaw-rate authority
do not stop a mode-generation rollout on obstacle collision because the obstacle is disabled for the entry positive control
do not substitute aggregate all-wheel slip for rear-axle truth
do not train a policy or mutate ActiveSafetyReflexDriver
do not claim reachable-set dominance, final paper support, production ESC failure, promotion, or self-ID from M3266

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: new matched planar and Chrono closed-loop mode-generation data with axle-specific tire truth and onset timing
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: same-plant slide expressibility and onset pricing only; no reachable-set verdict
stop_condition: stop and block final adjudication if the classifier or same-plant entry positive control fails
stop and block final adjudication if rear-axle telemetry or best replay fails
stop after onset rows, review, scoreboard, and ledger state are written
do not interpret onset timing as collision-avoidance feasibility
fallback_plan: if planar entry fails, stop the proof route because the current-sim matched arm is not expressible
if Chrono classifier passes but entry fails, report a plant/authority or search limitation and do not broaden claims
if axle telemetry fails, repair or escalate the connector before any final run
if all gates pass, register final adjudication separately with free, grip, and required-slide oracles
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M3265 full proof-route pricing failed its deliberate-slide expressibility gate on 2026-07-10

training_stage.stage_objective: Measure detailed-plant slide generation and onset without obstacle-clearance adjudication or policy training.
admission_evidence: M3265 known-counterexample sensitivity, search health, exact determinism, and Chrono telemetry gates passed
M3265 isolated the remaining blocker to deliberate-slide mode expressibility in short collision-terminated cells
existing F2/E4 artifacts show high-sideslip states are representable when initialized near the drift operating cell
next_stage_criteria: final adjudication is admitted only if every M3266 full gate passes
the final experiment must keep the M3265 literature positive control and M3266 detailed-plant entry positive controls
the final experiment must use matched per-arm oracle budgets and disjoint validation streams
the final full Chrono run must be managed and resumable

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M3266 optimizes open-loop action sequences against explicit body and tire state readouts; no history attribution is made.
history_necessity_tests: none; no learned history policy is evaluated
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Any failed classifier, entry, axle-telemetry, or replay gate blocks final adjudication and cannot be read as no-drift evidence.
allowed_claims: same-plant deliberate slide was or was not expressible under the frozen search
earliest measured slide onset time and distance in the frozen cells
front- and rear-axle Chrono slip telemetry was or was not available
final adjudication was admitted or blocked

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: adds obstacle-independent mode-generation data, onset timing, direct Chrono CEM, classifier positive control, and axle-specific telemetry absent from M3265
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: M3266 still cannot establish the paper's dominance claim; it only removes or confirms the mode-expressibility blocker.
must_synthesize_if: M3266 fails same-plant mode entry after M3265 failed emergency-cell expressibility
another local action parameterization is proposed after a full M3266 failure
mode thresholds are proposed to change after result inspection

success_criteria: the preregistration exists before quick and full execution
the quick artifact exists and passes before full execution
all three full planar cells produce mode_valid=true from beta=0 and persist onset time/distance
the Chrono beta=0.24 classifier positive control is mode_valid with axle-specific tire telemetry
the obstacle-disabled Chrono beta=0 direct CEM produces mode_valid=true with rear slip >=0.15 rad
the best Chrono action sequence replays within 1e-9
the artifact keeps dominance_claim_admitted=false and changes no incumbent
failure_criteria: full mode runs before preregistration or quick smoke
any planar same-plant entry cell fails mode validity
the Chrono classifier or beta=0 entry positive control fails
thresholds, dwell, actuator authority, or seed discipline change after result inspection
M3266 is used for a final reachable-set, paper, promotion, production-ESC, or self-ID claim
decision_rule: Accept M3266 as completed and admit a separately registered final adjudication only if M3265's literature positive control remains true, all planar beta=0 entry cells pass, onset rows are complete, the Chrono beta=0.24 classifier and beta=0 direct-entry searches pass with rear-axle truth, and the best Chrono trajectory replays within 1e-9. Any failure blocks the proof route.
